description: This file defines the HTMLColumn class within the FooTable plugin, extending the base Column class to handle raw HTML content in table cells. It includes methods for parsing cell values or jQuery elements and registers this class with the FooTable columns registry.

classes.name: FooTable.HTMLColumn
classes.description: A class used to handle raw HTML columns in a FooTable, extending the base Column class to interpret cell content or HTML elements.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor for the HTMLColumn class, initializing it with the parent Table instance and definition object, and specifying 'html' as the type.

methods.name: parser
methods.description: Parses a given value or jQuery element in a table cell to extract either raw HTML content or data, supporting string inputs and DOM elements.
